summary: Iteration 9 — Comprehensive testing of Axistra Portal v3 deliverables (Treasury → Wallet Ledger fan-out, idempotency, cascade delete, OxaPay sync endpoint, multi-coin Wallet Ledger UI, gap-fill regression). All 9 backend pytest cases pass; all 5 frontend wallet-card / Convert-button assertions pass.
critical_code_review_comments: wallets.service.ts sourceWalletFor() can return 'MANUAL' which is NOT in the WalletCode enum (OXAPAY/BTCPAY/BINANCE/OKX/WIO_BANK). If a recharge ever has no payment_gateway (or an unmapped one), the step-okx pair will attempt to write to a non-existent wallet and may corrupt the ledger. Recommend defaulting to BINANCE or throwing a clear validation error in syncMovementStep when source resolves to MANUAL.

Idempotency relies on deterministic external_ref + delete-then-insert. Concurrent POSTs to the same /treasury/movement/:id could race and briefly leave the wallet with 0 rows or duplicates. Consider wrapping syncMovementStep in a per-recharge advisory lock if multi-user concurrency is expected.
Frontend WalletLedger.jsx shows OXAPAY hint text 'auto-converted to USDT' — make sure the original_coin column header reads 'Customer Paid' only on the OXAPAY-active view (which it does).
seed_data_creation: Each test creates its own customer/recharge with TEST_ prefix and cleans up via DELETE in fixture teardown. No persistent test data left behind. Gap-fill test creates+deletes customers to verify code-slot reuse.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite is at /app/backend/tests/test_treasury_fanout.py — run with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<preview_url> pytest .... Customer/recharge creation REQUIRES full_name/email/phone/country/magnus_username. crypto-tx call REQUIRES either receiving_wallet (address) OR received_wallet (wallet code like BINANCE). Treasury movement step counts: OKX wallet ends with 4 ledger rows after full chain (batch_in + convert_from + convert_to + cashout), Binance has 1 (batch_out), WIO_BANK has 1 (bank_deposit). OxaPay sync endpoint returned scanned=0, errors=0 (expected with sandbox merchant keys).
